facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 27 November 2023 a planned assurance activity of PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices not effective.
